english.note: This is the all-purpose way to say that someone or something is in danger or at risk.
This is the all-purpose choice when someone or something is exposed to danger or risk.

examples.english: This species of sea turtle is endangered and may become extinct.
examples.traditional: 呢種海龜有危險，可能會絕種。
examples.jyutping: ni1 zung2 hoi2 gwai1 jau5 ngai4 him2 ho2 nang4 wui5 zyut6 zung2

examples.english: That old building is compromised, so don't go near it.
examples.traditional: 嗰座舊大廈仲有危險，唔好行埋去。
examples.jyutping: go2 zo6 gau6 daai6 haa6 zung6 jau5 ngai4 him2 m4 hou2 haang4 maai4 heoi3
